next_step: Finish extension POC (50 devs) + demo telemetry dashboard; finalize pricing/commit for Dedicated nodes
blockers: SSO provisioning via SCIM not completed
notes:
Product team focused on VS Code extension copilot. Wants streaming token-level responses for inline completions (keystroke latency ~<40ms ideal).
- Primary ask: live streaming API with partial tokens so suggestions feel instant while typing.
- Need model/version pinning per workspace and ability to rollback quickly. "Reproducible suggestions" is a selling point for their customers.
- Concern: token-level billing attribution per dev + per-extension quota controls. They asked about per-API-key throttles and per-user rate limits.
- Security: SSO/SAML + SCIM for user provisioning, Audit logs for every prompt + response, KMS support for key rotation, EU data residency for EMEA customers.
- POC: 50 internal devs using extension for 3 weeks, metrics of interest: suggestion acceptance rate, latency p95, per-user token usage.
- Integration notes: extension creates ephemeral API keys via backend; want Redwood hosted tokens to be issuable short-lived and revocable. Also exploring Dedicated for predictable latency during large org trials.
- Quote from CTO: "If streaming feels snappy and we can pin models per workspace, this becomes our core differentiator vs others."
- Competitive constraints: Marketplace listing rules, telemetry opt-in for users, don't want source code leakage—need clear prompt/response retention policy.
- Misc: asked for example rollout policy for canarying a new model in extension, and for SDK example for partial-token streaming in Typescript.

poC_plan: 3-week internal cohort (50 devs) using VS Code extension. Week1: baseline with hosted small model; Week2: enable streaming + pin to v1.2; Week3: stress test with 200 concurrent builds to surface latency and rate limit issues. Deliverables: telemetry dashboard link, acceptance metrics, recommendation to move to Dedicated if p95 > 120ms under expected concurrency.
technical_requirements:
- Low-latency streaming (partial-token flush)
- Model pinning per workspace
- Per-user and per-project rate limits + quota reporting
- Short-lived API keys + revoke endpoint
- Audit logs and retention settings (configurable)
- KMS integration for customer-managed keys
- EU data residency option
pricing_notes: Interested in a committed Dedicated pool for predictable latency if POC metrics justify. Also wants units-based hosted pricing with clear per-developer cost estimates. Asked for example cost modeling (50 devs, 8 hours/day, average 30 tokens/suggestion).
deal_history: Qualified by SDR -> Intro AE call -> Security questionnaire -> Architecture workshop -> POC kickoff. No legal/POC contract signed yet.
recent_feedback:
- Performance: good at low concurrency; p95 spikes at 200 concurrent sessions during code-gen.
- UX: inline suggestion speed matters more than absolute model quality for adoption.
- Ops: need token billing reports per dev and automated quota alerts.
implementation_risks: SSO/SCIM mapping delays; insufficient per-user throttling causing noisy neighbor issues; lack of model rollback automation in extension; pricing uncertainties for Dedicated nodes.
acceptance_criteria: 1) p95 latency for inline suggestions <120ms at expected concurrency; 2) per-dev token billing visible in console; 3) SSO + SCIM provisioning working end-to-end; 4) audit logs available with 90-day retention by default; 5) model pin/rollback in extension tested
